name: APT Packaging Ltd.
summary: APT Packaging Ltd. specializes in the production of seamless, co-extruded plastic tubing. Their comprehensive product line features a wide array of tube shapes and dimensions, available in various colors and designed to hold fill volumes ranging from 10 ml to 300 ml. These tubes can be customized with an assortment of dispensing nozzles and orifices, accompanied by coordinating caps, and offer numerous decorative options. The company was established on April 24, 1980, and is primarily based in Aurangabad, India.
